parentType.description:
Type from parent action when {@link inst} is called, if there is a parent action.  This is used to get the proper
connection for other functions requiring a connection.  If there is no parent action, this will be null and the
type used for the connection will be the current context type at the time of any function call through the
instance.

datastore.description: Datastore to get connection for in non-default instance.

env.description: Environment to get connection for in non-default instance

app.description: App to get connection for in non-default instance
